questions.question: In animal cells, which membrane-bound cell organelles are generally smaller and help to separate waste products?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vacuoles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A vacuole **is a **membrane-bound cell organelle**.
 
• In **animal cells**, **vacuoles **are generally **small **and **help sequester waste products**.
 
• In **plant cells**, vacuoles **help maintain water balance**.
 
• **Sometimes **a **single vacuole **can take **up most of the interior space **of the **plant cell**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Plastids**__

 __
 
• **Plastids **are **double-membrane organelles **that are **found **in the **cells of plants and algae**.
 
• **Plastids **are responsible for manufacturing and **storing food**.
 
 
 
• **Cytosols**__
 __
 
• The **cytosol **is the **liquid medium contained **within a cell.
 
• The **cytosol **is a **component of the cytoplasm**.
 
 
 
• **Golgi apparatus**__
 
 
• The **Golgi apparatus**, also known as the **Golgi complex**, **Golgi body**, or simply the **Golgi**, is an **organelle **found in **most eukaryotic cells**.

questions.question: Agumbe, a biodiversity-rich region that receives 7640 mm of average annual rainfall in South India, is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Situated **in the **Shimoga district of Karnataka**, **Agumbe **gets its **sobriquet **because **it receives 7,640 mm **of mean **annual rainfall**, the **second highest annual rainfall **in **India**.
 
• **Flora: Agumbe **is surrounded by **rich biodiversity **and the hill station borders one of the last surviving **lowland rain forests**.
 
• **The warm moist winds **of the northward-moving air from the **Bay of Bengal **during the **monsoon**, cover an extensive area but are forced to converge into the narrower zone over the **Khasi Hills**, thus concentrating their moisture. That is the reason for heavy rainfall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The average rainfall **received in **Andhra Pradesh **from **01.06. 2020 to 09.03. 2021 **is recorded as **1095.7mm**.
 
• **Tamil Nadu **received **701.88 **mm of rainfall during the **NEM season **(**October-December**) against the normal **rainfall of 447.1 mm**.
 
• **Kerala is **among **India's high rainfall receiving states **and **records **an **annual rainfall of 2855 mm**.

questions.question: What resource is found in sedimentary rocks on the western and eastern flanks of the peninsula in Gujarat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Petroleum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sedimentary rocks **on the **western **and **eastern flanks **of the **peninsula**, in **Gujarat and Assam**, have most of the **petroleum deposits**.
 
• **Petroleum**, also **called crude oil**, is **a fossil fuel**.
 
• **Like coal **and **natural gas**, **petroleum **was **formed **from the **remains **of **ancient marine organisms**, such **as plants**, **algae**, and **bacteria**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Broadly speaking, peninsular rocks contain most of the reserves of coal, metallic minerals, mica, and many other non-metallic minerals
 
 
• Sedimentary rocks on the western and eastern flanks of the peninsula, in **Gujarat and Assam, have most of the petroleum deposits. **
 
• Rajasthan with the rock systems of the peninsula has reserves of many non-ferrous minerals.
 
• The vast** alluvial plains of north India** are almost devoid of economic minerals. 
 
• These variations exist largely because of the differences in the** geological structure, processes, and time involved in the formation of minerals.**

questions.question: A candidate seeking election as Vice-President is required to make a security deposit of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹15,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A candidate who contests an election for the posts of President and Vice President of India has to tender a security deposit amount is Rs 15,000 each.
 
• Droupadi Murmu is our current president and Jagdeep Dhankhar is the vice president of India.
 
• Every candidate has to make a security deposit of Rs 15,000 in the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• The security deposit is liable to be forfeited in case the candidate fails to secure one-sixth of the votes polled.
 
• Before 1997, the number of proposers and seconders was ten each and the amount of the security deposit was Rs 2,500.
 
• In 1997, they were increased to discourage non-serious candidates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Electoral College of Vice President:**

 
• As per Article 66 of the Constitution of India, The Vice President shall be elected by the members of an electoral college consisting of the members of both Houses of Parliament.

**The Electoral College of Vice President consists of:**

 
• **Elected and **Nominated **members of Rajya Sabha**.
 
• **Elected members of Lok Sabha.**

questions.question: Which ecologist’s research provided revolutionary new insights into how energy and nutrients move through the ecosystems?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Raymond L Lindeman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raymond Laurel Lindeman **(**1915 – June 29, 1942**) was an **ecologist **whose **graduate research **is **credited with being a seminal study in **the **field of ecosystem ecology**, **specifically **on the **topic of trophic dynamics**.
 
• **Lindeman completed **his **Ph.D**. at the **University of Minnesota **with his **thesis work **being concerned with the history and ecological dynamics of Cedar Bog Lake.
 
• **Some insights **of his research:
 
 
• **Energy is passed from one trophic level **to the **next trophic level**.
 
• Hence, **energy flows **in one **direction **through **successive trophic levels **in **a food chain**.
 
• **Nutrients **are **produced from the matter**. The **matter **may be **organic **or **inorganic**.
 
• The **organic **and **inorganic matter **is produced, exchanged, and moved within the **ecosystem **and this is **called cycling**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sir Arthur George Tansley **FLS, FRS (**15 August 1871 – 25 November 1955**) was an **English botanist **and a **pioneer **in the science of ecology.
 
• **Ernst Heinrich Philipp August Haeckel **was a **German zoologist**, **naturalist**, **eugenicist**, **philosopher**, **physician**, **professor**, **marine biologist, and artist**.
 
• **Charles Sutherland **Elton FRS (**29 March 1900 – 1 May 1991**) was an **English zoologist **and **animal ecologist**.

questions.question: Metabolic reactions in our body are carried out by:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**proteins**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Metabolism **is the **chemical reactions **in the body's **cells **that **change food into energy**.
 
• **Two types **of **metabolic reactions **take place **in the cell**: **'building up**' (**anabolism**) and '**breaking down'**(**catabolism**).
 
• **Specific proteins **in the body **control **the **chemical reactions of metabolism**.
 
• **Proteins **are **made **up of **hundreds **or **thousands **of **smaller units **called **amino acids**, which are attached to one another in long chains. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carbohydrates**, or **carbs**, are **sugar molecules**. Along with **proteins **and **fats**, **carbohydrates **are **one of the three main **nutrients found in **foods and drinks**. 
 
• Your body **breaks down carbohydrates **into **glucose**.
 
• **Glucose**, or **blood sugar**, is the **main source of energy **for your body's cells, tissues, and organs.
 
• **A lipid **is any of **various organic compounds **that are **insoluble in water**.
 
• They **include fats**, **waxes**, **oils**, **hormones**, and **certain components **of **membranes **and **function **as **energy-storage molecules **and **chemical messengers**.
 
• **A salt consists **of the **positive ion (cation) **of **a base **and the **negative ion (anion) **of **an acid**.
 
• The **reaction between **an **acid **and **a base **is **called **a **neutralization reaction**.
 
• The **term salt **is also used to refer specifically to **common table salt**, or **sodium chloride**.

questions.question: Identify the component that is unique only to prokaryotes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mesosome**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prokaryotes **are organisms** **whose **cells lack **a **nucleus **and other **organelles**.
 
• **Prokaryotes **are divided into two distinct groups: **bacteria **and **archaea**, which scientists believe have unique evolutionary lineages.
 
• **Most prokaryotes **are small,** single-celled organisms** that have a **relatively simple structure**.
 
• **Mesosome **is an **organelle **of **bacteria **that appears as an invagination of the **plasma membrane **and **functions either in DNA replication **and **cell division **or **excretion of exoenzymes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A nucleus**, as related to **genomics**, is the **membrane-enclosed organelle **within **a cell **that **contains the chromosomes**. 
 
• In the **nucleus **of **each cell**, the **DNA molecule **is **packaged **into **thread-like structures **called **chromosomes**.
 
• The **nuclear membrane **is a **double layer **that **encloses **the **cell's nucleus**, where the **chromosomes reside**. The nuclear membrane serves to **separate the chromosomes **from the **cell's cytoplasm **and **other contents**.

questions.question: Guru Shyama Charan Pati, was conferred the Padma Shri for his contributions to mainly which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhau nritya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Shyama Charan Pati**__

 __
 
• **Indian dancer Guru Shyama Charan Pati **was renowned as one of the foremost exponents of the **Seraikala lineage of Chhau, an Indian martial dance style**.
 
• He who was born in **1940** and belongs to a **low-income Brahmin family in the Icha village**.
 
• Under the guidance of **Guru Ban Bihari Acharya**, he received training in the dance forms of **Katthak and Bharatnatyam in Jamshedpur**.
 
• Later, he **studied** the numerous **Shaili forms with the foremost practitioners of the era, Panchanan Singhdev and Tarini Prasad Singhdev**.
 
• In **2006**, the Guru received the **Padma Shri**, the** fourth-highest honour bestowed **by the country, in recognition of **his unique contribution to Indian dance**.
 
• He played a significant role in introducing women to the **Chhau dancing style or Chhau nritya**.
 
• A well-known **Chhau dancer, Sushmita Pati, is his daughter**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau Nritya**

 
 
• A **semi-classical Indian dance incorporating martial and folk traditions** is called** chhau nritya**, which is also spelled as **chhou dance**.
 
• There are three distinct varieties of it:
 
 
• **the Purulia Chhau from West Bengal, **
 
• **the Seraikella Chhau from Jharkhand, **and
 
• **the Mayurbhanj Chhau from Odisha.**
 
 
 
• The dance includes both** structured dances with religious themes found in Shaivism, Shaktism, and Vaishnavism as well as celebratory dances that showcase martial arts, acrobatics, and athletic performances in festive themes**.
 
• **Purulia and Serakeilla** use** masks** to distinguish the **character while wearing various outfits that vary according to the styles**.
 
• **The Puranas, the Hindu epics Ramayana, the Mahabharata**, and other works of Indian literature are among the stories that **Chhau dancers portray** by their dance.

questions.question: Which of the following organisations won the Etienne Glichitch Award in May 2021?

options.text: Board of Control for Cricket in India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Etienne Glichitch Award, 2021**

 
 
• The **International Hockey Federation (FIH)** presented** Hockey India with the Etienne Glichitch Award on May 2021**, during the virtual conference held as part of the **47th FIH Congress**.
 
• The** FIH Honorary Awards were given** to honour a variety of **people, groups, and organisations for their extraordinary achievements towards the sport of hockey**.
 
• Hockey India was **one of three National Associations **that received recognition for their exceptional efforts with a variety of prizes.
 
• It was recognised for their** great commitment to the expansion and development of hockey through creative concepts**.
 
• **Gyanendro Ningombam**, the **president of Hockey India**, thanked FIH for recognising the **effort of Hockey India to develop the sport in India**.
 
• The honour is named after **Etienne Glichitch, who served as the Hon. Secretary of the FIH from 1966 to 1984, **when he became the President, a post which he held until 1996.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey India**

 
 
• All of **India's hockey-related events for both men and women** are **organised, managed, and carried out by Hockey India**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India **has acknowledged it as the only organisation in charge of developing hockey in India. 
 
• Hockey India, with its **headquarter in New Delhi**, was founded on** May 20, 2009, and is a member of the International Hockey Federation (FIH), the Indian Olympic Association (IOA), and the Asian Hockey Federation (AHF)**.
 
• Players at the **sub-junior, junior, and senior levels are trained by Hockey India** with assistance from the** Sports Authority of India and the Department of Sports, Government of India**.
 
• It was **established after the IOA disbanded **the **Indian Hockey Federation in 2008**.

questions.question: Banks issue KCC to support credit in agriculture. KCC stands for _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kisan Credit Card**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kisan Credit Card **

 
 
• The **Kisan Credit Card (KCC) **programme was launched in** August 1998 by Indian public sector banks** to provide** kisan credit cards to the country's farmers**. 
 
• On the advice of the **R. V. Gupta Committee, the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) created this model programme to give advances for agricultural requirements**.
 
• Its goal was to provide **financial assistance to farmers in order to meet the extensive credit requirements of the agricultural sector by 2019 **as well as those for fisheries and animal husbandry.
 
• All **commercial banks, regional rural banks, and state cooperative banks** are included in the list of participants.
 
• The** interest rate for KCC loans starts as low as 2% and averages at 4%**, thus farmers who use it are also exempt from the high interest rates associated with the regular loans provided by banks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana and the PM Kisan Credit Cards** are now connected. Farmers may apply for up to **Rs. 3 lakh** in 4% interest-bearing loans from KCC.
 
• **Characteristics and Benefits** of Kisan Credit Card
 
 
• Farmers are credited for meeting their **financial obligations for farming, other related activities, and post-harvest costs**.
 
• Investment financing for **agricultural necessities like dairy cows, pump sets**, etc.
 
• Farmers are eligible for **loans up to Rs. 3 lakh **as well as loans for produce marketing.
 
• Holders of KCC schemes are covered by** insurance up to Rs. 50,000 in the event of death or permanent incapacity**.
 
• In the event of other **hazards, a cover of Rs. 25,000 **is provided.
 
• In addition to the Kisan Credit Card, qualified farmers will also receive **a savings account with a competitive interest rate, a smart card, and a debit card**.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian Cricketers (Female) won Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithali Raj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mithali Raj**

 
 
• **Right-handed batter Mithali Dorai Raj **is an **Indian cricket player** who was born on **3 December 1982**.
 
• Between **1999 and 2022,** she was a member of the Indian team and** served as captain between 2004 and 2022**.
 
• She is also known as the **GOAT of women's cricket **and is regarded as one of the finest female cricketers of all time.
 
• In her career, which started in 1999, **Mithali Raj has amassed 7391 ODI runs, 2364 T20I runs, and 699 Test runs**, making her the top run-scorer in women's cricket. 
 
• **Ram Nath Kovind, the President of India, **presented Mithali Raj with the prestigious** Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021** during a ceremony, **November 13, 2021 at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi**.
 
• Mithali has won numerous national and international honours, including **the Padma Shri in 2015, Arjuna Award in 2003, and the Wisden Leading Woman Cricketer in the World in 2017**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 

 
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award, also referred to as Khel Ratna Award and formerly known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award **in Sports and Games, is **India's highest sporting honour**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** bestows it annually.
 
• The** honoree(s) is/are recognised** for their** "spectacular and most exceptional performance in the sphere of sports over a period of four years"** at an international level by a committee appointed by the Ministry.
 
• As of **2020**, the prize consists of a **medallion, a certificate, and 25 lakh ($31,000) in cash**.
 
• **Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient **of the honour, recognised for his efforts in **1991–1992**.

questions.question: Who among the following is the recipient of Sangeet Natak Akademi for Bharatanatyam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Geeta Chandran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geeta Chandran**

 
 
• **Indian singer and dancer Geeta Chandran **specialises in **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She **had her training in Carnatic music** and is a pioneering and **well-known Bharatanatyam artist** in India.
 
• She has also worked in **theatre, dance, education, videography, and films. Geeta Chandran has worked with dancers, musicians, authors, writers, poets, painters, theatre figures, academicians, philosophers, linguists, costume and fashion designers**, and others to further her skills in the classical arts.
 
• Her training in Bharatanatyam Abhinaya began at the foot of her first **Guru, Abhinaya Saraswathy**.
 
• She was then assisted in improving her abilities by **Gurus Jamuna Krishnan and Smt. Kalanidhi Narayanan**. 
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi Puruskar for Bharatanatyam** for the year **2016** has been awarded to Geeta Chandran.
 
• Chandran received **the Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in** 2007** for her contributions to the arts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Puruskar 

 
 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama, bestows the Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar**.
 
• It is the **highest honour bestowed to practicing artists** in India.
 
• Prior to** 2003, the prize came with a citation, a tamrapatra, an angavastram (a shawl), and Rs. 50,000**.
 
• Since **2009**, the cash prize has been increased to **₹1,00,000**.
 
• The awards are presented in the performing arts categories of **music, dance, theatre, other traditional arts, puppetry, and contribution/scholarship**.
